name: Diagnose Computer Problems
description: Investigate crashes, freezes, errors, and general 'something is wrong' problems by running real diagnostic tools on the user's computer
prompt: Run get_system_info and read_error_log. ONLY report what the tools actually return — do not invent errors or system specs. State the likely cause from the data and give 1-3 fix steps. If tools return nothing useful, say so and ask the user to describe what happened.
